tool.name: Merge.sfffiles
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets #for $i in $input: ln -s '$i' input${input.index($i)}.dat && #end for
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #set $mothur_arg = "sff=" #for $i in $input: #set $mothur_arg += "input" + str($input.index($i)) + ".dat-" #end for #silent $mothur_args.append($mothur_arg) #silent $mothur_args.append("output=merged.sff")
echo 'merge.sfffiles(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | sed 's/-,/,/g' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log && ## mothur 1.48's sff output pattern is "[filename],", which ends up chopping the last ## character off the name it was given: the 'merged.sff' requested above is written as ## 'merged.sf'. Rename it to the file name Galaxy handed us. mv merged.sf '$output'
tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
.. _Mothur: https://mothur.org/wiki/
**Command Documentation**
The merge.sfffiles_ command merge inputs into a single output.
.. _merge.sfffiles: https://mothur.org/wiki/merge.sfffiles/
